title: PAR-03 DXF 240-259 classification and ImageBackground wire correction

localScope.head: de27a33
localScope.worktreeState: The shared worktree is broadly dirty. This slice includes scoped source/test changes, the plan correction, and this receipt; no files were staged or committed.

evidence.finding: The published general value-type table describes 210-239 and resumes at 270-279, without assigning a general type to 240-259. The standalone classifier therefore does not guess a binary width.
The numerical reference likewise documents 210/220/230 and 270-279, without a general assignment for 240-259.
The IMAGE_BACKGROUND schema maps the offset pair from DXF 140 and the scale pair from DXF 142.
The ImageBackground writer emits offset.x/y at 140/141 and scale.x/y at 142/143. This is implementation corroboration, not format authority.

implementation.change: Classify 240-259 as Unknown in StandaloneSafe; retain their former Double interpretation only in LibreCadMasterLegacy. Correct IMAGEBACKGROUND output to write offset.y and scale.y at 141 and 143. Restrict parsing of historic 240/242 aliases to the explicit legacy profile.
assertions: Classifier boundaries 239/240/242/259/260/270 reflect the selected profiles.
ASCII unknown values in 240/242/259 retain source spelling rather than being read as stale doubles.
Standalone binary parsing and writing fail closed for the unknown 240-259 range.
Legacy-profile binary widths remain explicitly testable.
ASCII and Binary IMAGEBACKGROUND output place distinct Y offset/scale values at 141/143 and emit neither 240 nor 242.
implementation.fixturePolicy: The DXF controls are generated in memory/test temporary output; no DWG/DXF fixture file was added.

nextAction: Continue the code/context audit for standalone DXF 260-269 and other unassigned or context-sensitive spans; then self-unblock to the next locally actionable plan item without waiting on external gates.
